title: Escorted rollout for optimize recommendations with pause-on-delta and shadow simulation
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Implement an "escort" style gated deployer for Optimize suggestions that combines shadow-traffic simulation, pause-on-delta sentinels, and an approval lattice so operator intervention is easy and auditable. This ticket covers the orchestration layer (deployer), the canary policy DSL, observable checkpoints, and the rollback choreography for batching/caching recommendation auto-applies.

Scope and non-goals:
- In scope: orchestrator service changes, canary policy evaluation hooks, metric thresholds (latency P50/P95, token cost delta, error rate), shadow-run harness, operator approval UI hooks in Console.
- Out of scope: new model kernels or runtime quantization work (those should be separate runtime tickets).

Design decisions so far:
- Use shadow-traffic replay to simulate impact of batching/caching changes against a sampled production trace before any live activation. This gives a low-risk estimate of latency and unit-cost delta.
- Introduce "pause-on-delta" sentinel: if any monitored metric exceeds a configured delta or regression (absolute or relative) during canary, the deployer pauses and creates an operator escrow. The escrow requires an explicit approval from a named oncall or the ML reviewer to continue.
- Canary policy expressed as a small JSON DSL attached to each recommendation: {traffic_partition, duration_minutes, metrics: [{name, comparator, threshold, sensitivity}]}. The orchestrator will evaluate metric streams and produce a pass/fail verdict every minute.
- Approval lattice: multi-level approvals (owner -> ops -> sec) supported; approvals are recorded with timestamp, approver, and rationale. Reqs: must persist in audit log pedestal and be surfaced in Console.

Telemetry and SLOs to watch (initial):
- Latency P50/P95 change vs baseline (target < +5% P95).
- Per-token cost delta (target savings >= 1% for nontrivial recs).
- Error-rate (production 5xx) absolute increase threshold 0.05%
- Retry storm indicator (retry rate and queue growth)

Rollout plan:
1) Implement shadow-run collector and integrate with existing telemetry stream (Dashboard: https://dash.redwood-internal/optimize/shadow-run).
2) Build canary evaluator service (stateless) that consumes shadow results and live metrics; emits checkpoint events to orchestrator.
3) Implement pause-on-delta hooks and operator escrow creation (persist in audit store).
4) Console: lightweight approval panel for the escrow with pre-filled template rationale, links to PR, diff, and shadow simulation report.
5) Run an internal experiment (10% of team traffic mirrored) and validate rollback scenarios.

Acceptance criteria:
- Shadow simulation produces a report that contains latency/cost/error projections and a risk score.
- Deployer pauses automatically when sentinel thresholds breached and creates an escrow event.
- Approvals can be recorded and are required to unpause when policy requires human review.
- Full rollback path documented and auto-triggerable if post-deploy metric drift exceeds rollback thresholds.

Artifacts and links:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optimize/pull/1428 (draft)
- Design doc: https://docs.redwood/internal/optimize/escort-rollout (draft)
- Shadow dashboard: https://dash.redwood-internal/optimize/shadow-run
- Eval harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optimize-evals/tree/escort-harness
